children: Palm oil (FCPOc3) may revisit its August 21 high of 5,031 ringgit per metric ton, as the uptrend from 4,614 ringgit could have resumed.
The resumption was confirmed by a strong rise in the previous trading session. The contract has climbed above a falling trendline and managed to stabilize above it.
A bullish wedge has thus been more or less confirmed, suggesting a target around 5,200 ringgit. A break below 4,978 ringgit may trigger a fall into the 4,893-4,946 ringgit range.
On the daily chart, the uptrend looks steady within a rising channel, which indicates a target around 5,217 ringgit, close to 5,200 ringgit (hourly chart).
The consolidation over the past few weeks is considered an accumulation of the bullish momentum. A strong rally is likely to follow.
